title: Algebraic constructions of code lattices in Narain conformal field theories
summary: We give new results on the structure and representations of the three lattices $\mathbf{Λ}_{\mathrm{k}},\mathbf{Λ}_{\mathrm{k}\mathcal{C}},\mathbf{Λ}_{\mathrm{k}}^{\ast }$ relevant to code CFTs realizing Narain conformal field theories. In this construction, $\mathbf{Λ}_{\mathrm{k}}^{\ast }$ denotes the dual of the even lattice $\mathbf{Λ}_{\mathrm{k}}$ and $\mathbf{Λ}_{\mathrm{k}\mathcal{C}}$ is an even self-dual intermediate lattice with a (d,d) signature.
